questions: Have you noticed any double vision?
Is the double vision worse when looking to one side?
Is the double vision worse looking up or down?
When the double vision occurs, does it go away if you close either eye?
Does the double vision come and go, or is it constant?

Do you have any pain around your eye or behind your eye?
Have you ever been told you have "lazy eye" or strabismus as a child?
